property_summary: For any non-empty recipient array and any valid recording callee, transferring through c must deliver exactly one call per recipient with the exact transferFrom(address,address,uint256) selector and calldata encoding (from, to, v); the mutant sends calldata with selector transfer(address,uint256) and ABI-shaped as (from, v), which the callee decodes as a different function and records as a malformed/short transferFrom, so the recorded per-recipient transferFrom(from,to,v) facts fail for some input.
change_summary: Change the transferFrom selector hash string to a different signature, causing the external call to invoke an unexpected function and likely revert or behave differently.
